title: Nanhi Zahra Hun Zara Samjho
body:
Ay ahle jafa, ay ahle jafa
Sookha hai gala, mera jurm hai kya
Hayee Sakina,
Hayee hayee Sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
Nanhi Zahra hun zara samjho aise na maaro, aise na maaro
Khud main deti hun tumhe nocho na yun meray gohar
<<DIVIDER>>
Mujhko itna to bata do kay bigara kya hai
Aik beemar siwa mera sahara kya hai
Mere sadmon nay jhuka di hai jawani mein qamar
<<DIVIDER>>
Main to kehti hun zibah kar ke sina le aao
Mujhko manzoor hai Baba say aisay milwao
Sath Baba kay karun gi main khushi se ye safar
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya Khuda nay nahi di tumko koi aulaadein
Apne bachon ki suni tu nay nahi hain aahein
Isliye hota nahi meray ye ronay ka asar
<<DIVIDER>>
Kahan sina ki ye nokein kahan masoom si jaa
Main kahan tak bhala dorun gi in kay sath yahan
Beth bhi sakti nahi teray tamachon ka jo dar
<<DIVIDER>>
Harf saray hi salamat ke yun dam tor gaye
Teray zakir ki tarah jo bhi jahan chor gaye
Dena mehshar mein inhe apni azaa ka tu samar
